title: Reduced Fat Mayonnaise with Olive Oil

content.title: About
content.content: Reduced fat mayonnaise with olive oil is a lighter version of classic mayonnaise, where part of the vegetable oil is replaced by olive oil and the overall fat level is lowered using water and stabilizers. The product retains a creamy texture and characteristic taste while providing fewer calories and more beneficial monounsaturated fats.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Olive oil gives the mayonnaise a subtle fruity aroma.
Fat reduction is achieved with emulsifiers that keep water stably dispersed.
Often chosen by people watching their weight but not wanting to give up the familiar flavor.
Olive‑oil based mayonnaise tends to be more stable during storage than versions made with refined oils.
In many markets it is marketed as a "healthier" alternative for salads and sandwiches.

items.title: Lower Calorie Content
items.content: Reduced fat means fewer calories per serving compared with traditional mayonnaise.

items.title: Monounsaturated Fatty Acids
items.content: Olive oil is rich in oleic acid, which supports cardiovascular health.

items.title: Vitamin E
items.content: Olive oil provides vitamin E, an antioxidant that protects cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Easier Digestion
items.content: Emulsifiers and added water make the product lighter on the stomach.

items.title: No Trans Fats
items.content: Unlike some conventional mayonnaises, this version contains no trans fats.

items.title: Egg Allergy
items.content: Traditional mayonnaise contains egg yolk, which can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Sodium Content
items.content: Despite lower fat, the product may still contain a notable amount of salt; people with hypertension should monitor intake.

items.title: Shelf Life After Opening
items.content: Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 1‑2 weeks.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some formulations include preservatives that may not be suitable for those avoiding additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Use reduced fat olive oil mayonnaise as a salad dressing, sandwich spread, in rolls, or as a base for sauces. It works well in recipes that require a creamy texture while keeping calories lower.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the product in the refrigerator at 2 °C‑6 °C. After opening, seal tightly to prevent air exposure. Do not keep at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
